adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the decrypted `keys` are produced via `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` and then written directly to `prisma.credential.update/create` (`data: { key: keys }`) with no validation against any app-specific credential schema. This makes it possible to persist structurally invalid credential payloads and still return `200` (“Credentials updated/created...”), deferring failures to later usage (e.g., token refresh/parsing elsewhere). Also, the handler does not check `req.method`, so non-POST requests are not explicitly rejected (it will attempt to parse `req.body` regardless).
